pages.title: Decontamination Scrubber
pages.text: Melts radioactive waste into glass, and takes the uranium back out of spent fuel.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Vitrifies fission products and spent fuel salt into Nuclear Waste Glass, and recovers the uranium from spent fuel rods.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Nuclear Waste Glass, Uranium-238 Pellet.
